split.basis: 15 dev questions from the main body; 5 test questions from Appendix A; fixed before any embedding or retrieval run.
split.leakage_risk: One document; Appendix A repeats some main-body concepts. This is a section-level split, not independent-document or fully independent-topic testing.

filter.origin: PDF section boundaries verified against contents and physical pages 51 and 58.
filter.input_policy: Only question or user context supplies filters before search. Never derive them from gold source/page/answer.
filter.no_filter_policy: Strategy C runs unfiltered when the question has no filter.

selection_rule: Then choose strategy ID lexicographically to break a remaining tie
test_policy: Freeze strategies and choose on dev before reading test retrieval results. Evaluate the same five test questions for all fixed strategies; no tuning using test scores.
hit_definition: A single chunk must have a valid gold source/page and enough evidence. Exact whitespace-normalized evidence matching is a proxy; any manually confirmed equivalent evidence must be recorded. Combining partial evidence from multiple chunks cannot replace the primary hit definition.

audit_plan.coherence: Same first 10 included physical pages and normalized char offset 200, selected before chunk outputs. Labels 0/1/2 entered only after reviewing actual chunks.
audit_plan.metadata: All top-3 results for five test questions per strategy; compare fields to source.
audit_plan.grounding: Five test queries per strategy, explicit 0/1/2 labels and reasons; not LLM answer accuracy.

strategy_policy.limitation: A-B compares chunking policies including overlap, not boundary placement alone. B-C isolates filtering.

embedding_policy: Local real embedding model, same model/version/dimensions/query-document preprocessing for A/B/C. Select and pin in stage 4 before model use; none selected/downloaded/loaded yet.
vector_store: Existing PostgreSQL + pgvector, cosine metric; not ingesting vectors in stages 1-3.
evidence_review: Assistant drafted questions and checked source context, with literal evidence validation. User review and audit grades have not been claimed.
